pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions; zero pyramiding permitted unless the initial trade is safely moved to break-even + commission.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility filter: block all entries when 5-minute spread or tick velocity exceeds 2.5x the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST at +$15.00 to +$30.00, eliminating hesitation and preventing floating profits from evaporating.
